802	-- supabase/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_add_status_history.sql

804	  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status_history jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb;
805	
806	-- Trigger: append to status_history on status column update
807	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_bookings_append_status_history()
808	RETURNS TRIGGER
809	LANGUAGE plpgsql
810	SECURITY DEFINER
811	AS $$
812	BEGIN
813	  IF OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
814	    NEW.status_history = COALESCE(OLD.status_history, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
815	      'from', OLD.status,
816	      'to',   NEW.status,
817	      'at',   NOW(),
818	      'by',   COALESCE(auth.uid()::text, 'system')
819	    );
820	  END IF;
821	  RETURN NEW;
822	END;
823	$$;

826	CREATE TRIGGER trg_bookings_status_history
827	  BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON bookings
828	  FOR EACH ROW
829	  EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_bookings_append_status_history();

23	- **exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true** — never use `prop?: T` when the actual type is `T | undefined` narrowly. Use `prop?: T` only when the union is intentional. Spread optional props conditionally.
24	- **color-mix() for alpha** — `color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary) 4%, transparent)` is the correct way to produce alpha variants of token colors. Never `oklch(... / 0.04)` in CSS rules.
